nodes.rationale: Runs on pull requests to main with VALIDATE_ALL_CODEBASE=false (changed files only); docs and .github dirs excluded, markdown validation disabled.

nodes.label: opencode AI Agent (anomalyco/opencode)

nodes.label: githublogen Changelog Generator
nodes.rationale: Invoked via npx on every pushed v* tag to generate release notes from conventional commit history.

nodes.label: rev3-admin-base-web branch
nodes.rationale: Created 2026-06-11 from example HEAD 8be6f9ba so rev3 integration work stays isolated from upstream-aligned example/main branches, allowing future upstream rebases without disturbing integration, and isolating from new-admin-base-web (fork260509), rev1- and rev2- workspace branches so the four workspaces do not interfere.

nodes.label: rev3-admin-root umbrella repo
nodes.rationale: Umbrella integration repo (fork260509-rev3) that references the fork as the base-web submodule working branch.

nodes.label: SoybeanAdmin
nodes.rationale: Clean, elegant admin template built on Vue3, Vite8, TypeScript, Pinia, UnoCSS and NaiveUI; ships theme configuration, i18n, automated file routing and an ApiFox-based online mock solution as a one-stop out-of-the-box admin starter.

nodes.label: SoybeanUI
nodes.rationale: Vue 3 component system built on a two-layer Headless + UI architecture to reuse interaction logic and unify interface expression.

nodes.label: Elegant Router
nodes.rationale: Automated file routing system that generates route imports, declarations and types for SoybeanAdmin.

nodes.label: SoybeanJS Code Specification
nodes.rationale: Strict code standard followed by the project, enforced through eslint, prettier and simple-git-hooks.

nodes.label: pnpm Monorepo Architecture
nodes.rationale: pnpm monorepo keeps the project structure clear and elegant; npm/yarn installs are explicitly unsupported.

nodes.label: rev3-admin-rust-api 分支來源紀錄
nodes.rationale: Pure branch metadata record (created 2026-06-11); does not affect program logic; documents how to diff rev3-admin-rust-api against main

nodes.label: rev3-admin-rust-api branch
nodes.rationale: Created 2026-06-11 from main HEAD 32c5254 (Initial commit, 2026-05-26) as the rust-api submodule working branch for the rev3-admin-root umbrella monorepo; all integration changes go into this dedicated branch so `main` stays clean for any future upstream/reference alignment; no squash/rebase/history rewrite; same starting point as rev2's rev2-admin-rust-api but evolves independently

nodes.label: miso168net/fork260509-rev2-anew-rust-api repo
nodes.rationale: Built anew from scratch (not a fork of any upstream); the `rev2` in the repo name is the permanent GitHub repo name and does not change for the rev3 workspace — only the working branch was renamed rev2-admin-rust-api → rev3-admin-rust-api; distinct from fork260509-soybean-admin-rust (the rust fork used by rev1/fork260509)

nodes.label: Rust axum + Casbin backend (planned)
nodes.rationale: Stated purpose of the repo: implement a Rust axum + Casbin backend serving as rust-api in the rev3 integration

nodes.label: SoybeanAdmin Logo
nodes.rationale: The SoybeanAdmin brand mark exists in two visual renderings: (1) a geometric faceted emblem built from 7 interlocking curved-ribbon path segments filled with indigo/blue linear gradients (#373ebf, #5058e6, #646cff, #91a7ff, #c2d6ff - a Vite-like indigo palette), used where full-color branding fits (favicon, docs site logo); (2) an organic soybean-sprout line drawing filled with currentColor, used inside the app UI (svg-icon) so it inherits theme color. The gradient version is fixed-color and theme-independent, which is why it is the favicon; the currentColor version adapts to dark/light theme in-app.

nodes.label: At-Sign Icon (Feather @ symbol, local SVG asset)
nodes.norm_label: at-sign icon (feather @ symbol, local svg asset)

nodes.label: banner.svg — flat-style hero illustration: a person presenting a large analyt…
nodes.rationale: Accent shapes use fill="currentColor" (with opacity overlays) instead of hard-coded brand colors, so the illustration automatically inherits the app's primary theme color when rendered with a `text-primary` class; neutral greys (#ebebeb/#f0f0f0/#fafafa) and fixed dark/skin tones (#263238/#7f3e3b) stay constant. This makes one asset adapt to any user-selected theme color.
nodes.norm_label: banner.svg — flat-style hero illustration: a person presenting a large analyt...

nodes.label: Cast Icon (Feather screen-cast glyph)
nodes.description: Feather-style stroke icon (class feather-cast, 24x24 viewBox, stroke=currentColor) depicting a display/monitor outline with wireless-broadcast arcs radiating from its bottom-left corner and a dot beneath — the standard 'screen cast / streaming to display' symbol (Chromecast-like). Part of the base-web local SVG icon collection (src/assets/svg-icon/) consumed by the soybean-admin local-icon system; stroke uses currentColor so the icon inherits theme color at render time.

nodes.label: Copy SVG Icon
nodes.description: Classic 'copy to clipboard' icon: two overlapping rounded rectangles (a front 13x13 rect over a partially visible back sheet), drawn as 3px rounded strokes with fill=none and stroke=currentColor so it inherits the surrounding text color. One of the local SVG assets in base-web/src/assets/svg-icon/ that are bundled into the project's local icon collection.

nodes.label: base-web local SVG icon convention (src/assets/svg-icon)
nodes.rationale: SVG files placed in base-web/src/assets/svg-icon/ are auto-registered as local icons (icon-local-* prefix / SvgIcon component) so the app can ship offline, theme-colorable icons without depending on remote Iconify fetches; aria-hidden and currentColor keep them accessible and theme-aware.

nodes.label: empty-data.svg — empty-state illustration
nodes.rationale: 500x500 flat vector empty-state scene: pale gray elliptical ground; on the left a stack of five isometric dark blue-gray (#263238/#455a64/#37474f) storage crates/server boxes with rows of small LED-like indicator dots and theme-colored accent stripes; center shows a large tilted white document board whose 'NO D...' letterforms (N/O/D glyphs) are drawn as vector paths, signalling 'no data'; upper right a theme-colored magnifying glass (loupe) with handle, implying a fruitless search; flat platform cards sit at lower right. All accent elements use fill="currentColor" so the highlight color inherits the surrounding text/theme color.

nodes.label: currentColor theme-adaptive accent technique
nodes.rationale: Dozens of paths in the illustration are filled with currentColor instead of a hard-coded hex value, while structural parts keep fixed grays. This lets the same SVG asset recolor its accent stripes, loupe, and highlight planes to whatever theme/primary color the host component applies via CSS `color`, avoiding per-theme asset duplication — the standard convention for soybean-admin local svg-icon illustrations.

nodes.label: Empty-state UI illustration pattern
nodes.rationale: The asset exists to communicate 'no data to display' in lists/tables/dashboards. It belongs to the same illustration family as the sibling exception assets in src/assets/svg-icon/ (no-permission.svg, not-found.svg, service-error.svg, network-error.svg), all consumed through the base-web local icon collection registered by the build plugins (build/plugins/unplugin.ts and unocss.ts point at src/assets/svg-icon).

nodes.label: Expectation Illustration (expectation.svg)
nodes.rationale: Large Freepik stock vector illustration (72KB, viewBox 0 0 500 500) depicting a celebratory anticipation scene: a couple of human characters, an additional single character, falling confetti, a potted plant, a floor line, and a detailed room background (picture frames, shelf, desk objects). Group ids are freepik--background-complete / Floor / Couple / Character / Plant / Confetti. Accent areas (clothing etc.) use fill:currentColor in 22 places so the artwork inherits the active theme's primary color from its container instead of needing per-theme asset variants; remaining fills are fixed grayscale (#ebebeb/#e0e0e0) and skin/outline tones (#ffbe9d/#263238). Serves as the 'coming soon / look forward' placeholder graphic in base-web.

nodes.label: LookForward component
nodes.rationale: Placeholder page component for unfinished features: renders the expectation illustration at text-400px inside a text-primary wrapper (which feeds currentColor into the SVG) plus an i18n caption common.lookForward, with a default slot to override the caption.

nodes.label: Local SVG Icon Collection (base-web svg-icon assets)
nodes.rationale: Icons placed in src/assets/svg-icon are registered as local icons (local-icon prefix) and rendered via the SvgIcon component / unplugin-icons pipeline, so project-specific artwork like the logo can be used the same way as iconify icons.
nodes.norm_label: local svg icon collection (base-web svg-icon assets)

nodes.label: network-error.svg (network error illustration)
nodes.description: Flat-style 500x500 vector illustration depicting a network/connectivity error state: a person stands next to an oversized smartphone whose screen shows a WiFi symbol overlaid by a large circle-with-diagonal-slash (no-connection sign). The phone has a realistic status bar (clock digits, signal-strength bars, small WiFi icon with dot, battery outline). Scene props include a wilted potted plant, a chair with striped cushion, a window-grid pane, and a ground line. Dark strokes/fills use #263238; accent areas (background blob, slashed circle, person's clothing, cushion) use fill=currentColor so the illustration adapts to the app theme color. Asset lives in base-web src/assets/svg-icon/, the local-icon directory of the soybean-admin Vue starter, intended as the network-error feedback/empty-state graphic.

nodes.label: currentColor theme adaptation in network-error.svg
nodes.rationale: The illustration's accent shapes (background blob, no-connection slash circle, clothing, cushion) are filled with currentColor instead of hard-coded hues, so when rendered through the app's SvgIcon/local-icon pipeline the graphic automatically inherits the active theme color, keeping error/empty-state pages visually consistent with any user-selected theme without shipping per-theme image variants.

nodes.label: defaultLocalIcon missing-icon fallback
nodes.rationale: The SvgIcon component hardcodes defaultLocalIcon = 'no-icon' so that when neither the iconify icon prop nor the localIcon prop resolves, it renders the local no-icon.svg asset. The asset is deliberately drawn as a broken heart (Fluent-emoji style: two pink/magenta gradient heart halves separated by a jagged crack), making a missing or misnamed icon visibly obvious in the UI instead of rendering nothing.

nodes.label: No-Permission (403) Illustration
nodes.rationale: 500x500 flat-vector scene: large isometric '403' digits next to an open door blocked by diagonal caution/barrier tape, a warning signboard with an exclamation mark and fine-print text, and a cartoon person standing to the right. Greys (#37474f/#455a64/#e0e0e0) carry the structure while accent shapes use fill=currentColor, signalling 'access forbidden' on the error page.

nodes.label: currentColor Theme-Adaptive SVG Coloring
nodes.rationale: The illustration's accent paths use fill="currentColor" instead of hard-coded hues so the artwork automatically inherits the active theme/primary color of the admin UI; only neutral greys and skin tones are fixed. This lets one asset match any theme without per-theme variants.

nodes.label: not-found.svg (404 Page Not Found Illustration)
nodes.rationale: Full-scene 404 error illustration (viewBox 0 0 500 500), not a simple glyph: an isometric vignette with two cartoon characters (one inspecting a floating parcel platform with an orbiting ring, one standing beside shipping boxes), decorative sparkle/asterisk accents, the headline text 'Page not found' and large '404' numerals. Accent shapes use fill="currentColor" so the artwork tints to the active theme's primary color at render time (ExceptionBase wraps the icon in a text-primary container), making the error art theme-adaptive without per-theme image assets.

nodes.label: ExceptionBase component
nodes.rationale: Single shared exception page component: an iconMap maps exception type '403'->'no-permission', '404'->'not-found', '500'->'service-error', and renders the selected local SVG icon at text-400px inside a text-primary wrapper plus a back-to-home button. Centralizes all error-page UI so each builtin error view is a one-line wrapper.

nodes.label: VisActor logo icon (visactor.svg)
nodes.rationale: Circular monogram logo of the VisActor open-source visualization suite (ByteDance; VChart/VTable). A single 200x200 path drawn with fill=currentColor so the icon inherits the surrounding theme/text color. Registered as a local svg-icon asset in base-web and consumed via route meta localIcon:'visactor' for the VChart and VTable plugin demo menu entries.
